From arcade classics to modern interactive games, there’s something for everyone. What made it even more exciting was that we got 20 rounds with 10 balls per person, which gave us plenty of time to enjoy, compete, and improve our game. The atmosphere was lively, with great lighting and energetic vibes, making it a perfect place to unwind with friends or family. We genuinely had a great time laughing, competing, and just enjoying the moment.

Hi everyone, we visited this place DICE DYNASTY (GHATKOPAR EAST) recently and honestly, please don’t get misled by the reviews. Our experience was extremely disappointing.

It was our first time visiting and we were excited, but it quickly turned into a nightmare. The staff, especially the owners, do not value feedback at all. If you don’t like a dish, they won’t replace it or compensate you. They still expect full payment even if you haven’t eaten it.

They also don’t mention anywhere that the café charges on an hourly basis. As first-time visitors, not a single staff member informed us, which felt very misleading.

But the worst part was the attitude. The owners were shockingly rude and lacked basic manners and hospitality. They start off acting polite and then suddenly show their true colours. We genuinely didn’t expect this kind of behaviour in Ghatkopar.

They even said they don’t care about customer experience or feedback because they already have “good reviews,” which was honestly unbelievable.

But the most horrifying part was the aggression. They used abusive words toward us, and there were absolutely no cameras anywhere in the café.
The owner became extremely aggressive and was on the verge of hitting one of our friends. They even started recording videos of us without our consent, despite the fact that we clearly told them we just wanted to pay and leave. It was the most terrifying and unsafe experience I have ever had at any café.

So please think twice before visiting. Save your time and money. You’re honestly better off buying a board game and playing at a friend’s place. I’ve never been this disappointed with a café here, and I truly hope no one else has to experience this.

featured_reviews.name: Pravandu Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Play 'n Learn is an exceptional destination that truly understands how to create a fun and engaging environment for children. From the moment you step inside, it's clear that this establishment prioritizes both entertainment and safety. The sheer variety of activities on offer ensures that every child, regardless of their interests, will find something to capture their imagination. 🤩

The staff at Play 'n Learn deserve significant commendation for their remarkable responsibility and attentiveness. Parents can relax knowing that their children are under a watchful and caring eye, allowing for a genuinely stress-free experience. This commitment to supervision, coupled with ample space for parents to unwind while still observing their little ones, creates a harmonious atmosphere where everyone can enjoy their time. Adding to the delightful experience, one of the staff members even came dressed as a beloved cartoon character, leading a dance activity that brought all the children together. This performance was delivered with such dedication and enthusiasm, set to delightful music, and it was evident that the kids absolutely loved every moment. 💃🕺🎶

The imaginative play opportunities at Play 'n Learn are particularly impressive. Children can dive into a world of pretend, acting as sellers or buyers at a vibrant fruit and veggie stand, fostering early concepts of commerce and interaction. 🥕🍎 For budding engineers, the chance to fix cars as mechanics provides a hands-on experience that sparks creativity. 🛠️ The facility also encourages empathy and care through activities like playing doctor or running a pretend vet clinic, allowing children to explore crucial social roles. 🩺🐾 Beyond structured play, there's a charming cafe within the premises, offering a good variety of food, coffee, and chai for those who need a culinary break. ☕🍰 Kids can also cruise around in their own foot-powered cars, adding another layer of physical activity and fun. 🚗💨

The dynamic play zones are equally captivating. A massive ball pit invites children to jump and "swim" through a sea of colorful spheres, providing endless laughter and physical engagement. 🤩🏊 The excitement continues with a range of musical instruments, cool slides that promise thrilling descents, and a bouncy trampoline perfect for energetic jumps. 🎶🎢🤸 For those with a building inclination, foam blocks allow for creative construction, while a pulley system offers a fascinating way to lift blocks high, introducing basic principles of mechanics. 🏗️🔗

Beyond the activities, the overall ambiance of Play 'n Learn is truly inviting. The carefully curated music selection is perfect for children, creating a lively yet pleasant backdrop. 🎵 The walls, adorned with calm, soft colors, contribute to a soothing and aesthetically pleasing environment. 🎨 A two-hour play session proves to be the ideal duration, providing ample time for children to explore and engage without becoming overtired. My child had an absolute blast, and I wholeheartedly recommend Play 'n Learn to any family seeking a memorable and enriching play experience. ✨

featured_reviews.name: pratik athawale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m extremely disappointed with the recent experience at this gaming café. The issue isn’t just about the pricing—it’s about honesty, consistency, and how you treat your customers.

On 31st May, we were charged ₹100 for a 3-hour session (10 PM to 1 AM), which clearly means the rate was ₹33/hr or a flat discount.

Again, on 4th July, we were charged ₹120 for 3 hours, which is ₹40/hr. Still under the so-called “₹80/hr” rate.

But on 18th July, the staff suddenly claimed that they’ve been charging ₹80/hr for the past 2 years and said happy hours have been discontinued which is a clear contradiction to our previous two visits.

We even showed them screenshots of payments from previous visits as proof, but instead of acknowledging the discrepancy, they bluntly denied ever charging less. The attitude was dismissive and unprofessional, as if we were trying to lie about our own payments.

To make matters worse, the place is equipped with CCTV cameras covering every corner. They could have easily verified our previous visits and payment timings, but they chose to ignore all evidence and continue arguing rather than resolve the issue professionally.

Let me be clear it’s not about ₹80 vs ₹50 per hour. When you have a group of 10 players, these inconsistent rates add up to a big difference. And the worst part is the lack of transparency and denial despite proof.

If this is how you treat your regular customers, I don't see a reason to return or recommend this place. It’s time you fix your communication, standardize your pricing, and treat your paying customers with basic respect.
